metadata.title: Edge-to-Edge Display in Capacitor Without Plugins
metadata.description: Learn how to properly configure edge-to-edge display in your Capacitor apps using the official adjustMarginsForEdgeToEdge config option - no plugins or hacks needed.
metadata.author: Martin Donadieu

metadata.keywords: Capacitor, edge-to-edge, Android 15, adjustMarginsForEdgeToEdge, mobile development, native configuration

blocks.text: Trying to implement edge-to-edge display in your Capacitor app?
You don't need any hacks, plugins, or workarounds. Capacitor has official support for edge-to-edge display through the
configuration option - it's just not widely documented.

Many developers struggle with edge-to-edge layouts in Capacitor apps, especially when targeting Android 15+. They often resort to custom plugins or CSS hacks to achieve the modern edge-to-edge look. But there's a better, native way.

Edge-to-edge display allows your app content to extend behind system bars (status bar and navigation bar), creating a more immersive, modern UI experience. Starting with Android 15, Google is pushing edge-to-edge as the standard for all apps.
